The problem states that only 1 % of the candles may explode (since 99 % are guaranteed not to).  
Out of the 50 000 candles made, that is  

\[
0.01 \times 50\,000 = 500 \text{ candles that could explode}.
\]

Among these “more dangerous” candles, 5 % also have the wet‑dog smell defect, so  

\[
0.05 \times 500 = 25
\]

candles both explode and smell like wet dog.

**Final answer: 25**
